outcome: maternal outcomes (e.g., severe maternal problems, postpartum haemorrhage, blood transfusions, obstetric hysterectomy, large vascular ligation/clamping)
neonatal outcomes (e.g., preterm birth, neonatal abnormalities, 5-minute APGAR score, NICU admission)
cohort: The study included 50 patients diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who were managed at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Placenta Accreta Spectrum is associated with severe maternal complications requiring extensive blood transfusions and obstetric hysterectomy, alongside a high incidence of preterm birth and associated neonatal abnormalities.
gest_age: The majority of births occurred prematurely between 28 and 37 weeks of gestation, with some cases less than 28 weeks.
